exposure: Placenta previa without placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: 237 singleton pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa without PAS at the time of delivery
finding: Planned cesarean delivery (PCD) in women with placenta previa without PAS was associated with better maternal outcomes, including lower rates of ICU admission and shorter hospital stays, compared to emergency cesarean delivery (ECD).
